name: offer-builder
description: Offer Builder. Writes the offer they can say yes to. One page: the problem in their own numbers, what they get, the price, the date it ships, and the way out, with the plain statement that it isn't finished yet. A lint refuses an offer that leaves any of that out or that leans on fake urgency, made-up proof and promises nobody can keep. Every offer waits for your yes. Use when the user says "write the offer", "make them an offer", "offer page", "proposal", "one-pager", "what do I send them", "they asked for details", or "founding customer offer".

findings.excerpt: python3 "${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/offer.py" draft --deal north-pier --get "Every late invoice chased automatically" \
